fix(material/slider): change slider to use MDC's token API (#27375)
original_hunk_review: The new mat/slider map defines the mat-slider prefix and theme-derived value-indicator opacity. Its unthemable/typography/density maps intentionally contain no slots at this revision; it is a new modern token model, not a legacy thumb/track model.

The new mdc/slider map supplies6px active track,4px inactive track,20px handle geometry, theme-dependent disabled/label/primary/accent/warn/elevation values and subtitle2 text. It declares several unused MDC slots null. None of those token files belongs to the independently owned16 model.

Token validation adds the MDC slider theme dependency, the new slot module and an m2.mdc.slider validation case. These are upstream development assertions; no upstream test is falsely claimed executed or ported into the library.

The modern slider theme removes using-mdc-theme/typography and the old _slider-color helper in favor of mat/mdc token maps, resolved elevation and direct color/typography/density slot emission. The four historical ordinary exports remain reachable from our finite facade, so this path cannot be excluded by considering only owned legacy selectors.

Modern structural SCSS changes its MDC static/theme configuration, inserts token-defined geometry/shadow/value-indicator slots and wraps existing input,transition,ripple,noop/focus rules. The owned legacy structure uses mat-slider wrapper/track/thumb/ticks, and no current modern implementation is mirrored or forked.
decision: Do not transplant this modern slider token-model and structural rewrite into the frozen add-on. The complete five-path patch adds mat/mdc token maps and token-validation slots, replaces modern mat-mdc-slider color/typography/density generation, and rewires modern structural CSS around token slots. The historical facade also publicly exports ordinary slider color/typography/density/theme, so the older main rationale that only legacy-slider matters is incomplete. Both complete ordinary and legacy theme sources retain untouched16 behavior, with only four ordinary vendor module-source relocations; all14 independently compiled custom/light/dark/raw-config CSS cases match the untouched tag per line and reject nonempty drift. Ordinary slider is outside the explicit13 current-runtime companion bridge roster; owned legacy slider and all finite historical Sass exports remain required. Current modern runtime/private token machinery is peer-owned and no owned runtime imports the modern slider component. Preserve historical selectors, palettes, namespace bindings, calls, aggregate membership and the original empty density behavior. No modern template/token implementation is copied, no consumer HTML/CSS/SCSS change or deviation is introduced, and no current modern-slider rendering or inherited-fix claim is made. Full651/498 packed Sass, native controls, floors and the independent audit remain open.

complete_source_bodies.only_change: Four @material module sources relocated to owned vendor/mdc; namespace bindings and all function/mixin bodies unchanged

cyph_sanity.observations: Two maintained mat-slider templates use NgModel and the historical thumb/tick/displayWith inputs via MatLegacySliderModule aliased as MatSliderModule; three styles use all-legacy-component-themes. No files changed and no build or deployment performed.
